author: Inside Edition
description: A sports car sped down a highway as police were in hot pursuit. The car slammed into another vehicle before smashing into a guardrail. Authorities approached the vehicle and the driver insisted he was not trying to get away. The driver was Vince McMahon, the former CEO of World Wrestling Entertainment. In July 2025, McMahon was charged with reckless driving and following too closely. The charge will be dropped in a year if he completes a pre-trial program and donates $1000 to charity.
title: New Video Shows Police Chase Involving Former WWE CEO In 2025

author: Inside Edition
description: New York City was shut down Monday by a historic cyclone that dumped almost two feet of snow. The city's mayor, Zohran Mamdani recruited citizen shovelers to clear the streets and sidewalks. Inside Edition found a team of snow shovelers cleaning streets in Manhattan. The recent snow in New York is wet, dense and heavy. It is hard work to clear, which is why it is known as "heart attack snow." Cardiologist Dr. Varinder Singh told Inside Edition how to shovel snow safely.
title: New York City Clears Snowy Streets With Help Of Citizen Shovelers

author: Inside Edition
description: A family was in distress looking for their son, Tucker Austin Martin. Little did they know that her son was caught sneaking into Mar-A-Lago. President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania were hosting a governors dinner at the White House as Martin was headed for Mar-A-Lago. The 21-year-old drove 700 miles from his family home in North Carolina armed with a shotgun and a gas canister. He snuck onto the grounds and was fatally shot by Secret Service agents.
title: Family Searched For Man Who Breached Mar-A-Lago Before He Was Killed

author: Inside Edition
description: The stars of the film "Sinners" Michael B. Jordan and Delroy Lindo walked on stage to present an award at the BAFTAs when someone in the audience started shouting obscenities, including the N-word. The insults came from John Davidson. He suffers from Tourette's syndrome, a neurological condition that causes involuntary motor and verbal tics. Later, BAFTAs host Alan Cumming attempted to apologize for the shocking outburst but for many that apology was not enough.
title: Outrage After Racist Slur By Man With Tourette's Interrupts BAFTAs

author: Inside Edition
description: Nick Reiner appeared in court after his arrest in the murders of his parents, famed director Rob Reiner and wife Michelle. His attorney entered a not guilty plea on his behalf. Nick Reiner spoke only once when he agreed to waive the right to a speedy preliminary hearing. He was arraigned in a Los Angeles courtroom. The judge confirmed the 32-year-old will continue to be held without bail. Legal analyst Royal Oakes spoke with Inside Edition's Jim Moret.
title: Nick Reiner Pleads Not Guilty In Killing Of His Parents

author: Inside Edition
description: This koala is a survivor! Meet Flowers. She was in bad shape after being hit by a car. Rescuers say she suffered a ruptured eye and fractured jaw. Lucky for her, she was brought to the Australia Zoo Wildlife Hospital in Queensland, where she was given excellent medical care. Although she is blind in one eye, she's recovering enough that her medical team is already planning her return to the wild. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Flowers The Koala Learning To Live With One Eye After Car Accident

author: Inside Edition
description: As former Prince Andrew faces potential imprisonment, there has been no sign of his ex-wife, Sarah Ferguson.
title: Where Is Sarah 'Fergie' Ferguson After Andrew Mountbatten's Arrest? #shorts

description: Marion Karawia uses her social media platforms to raise awareness for Marcus Gunn syndrome while advocating for people bullied for their physical appearance.
title: Creator With Marcus Gunn Syndrome Uses Platform To Empower Others #shorts
